text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other day, Gold City's manager and I got together to coordinate her schedule. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lately, Gold City has been busy every second of the day. I imagine it's physically taxing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer! I overslept! It's already past my reserved time on the machine, but maybe we can still get a spot?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well… so much for that idea. There are no time slots left.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. Here I am, making you waste your time too.
choice_data_list: You're probably just exhausted from all the recent work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but I'm losing out. It's me who decided I could do all this—running and modeling.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Literally, how can I not even take proper care of myself? I have to get over this fatigue!
choice_data_list: Don't be so hard on yourself. You'll just wind up more exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Besides, after that extra rest, you'll be able to work harder during training!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll only be wasting time if I spend it feeling sorry for myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm back on my feet. What have you got for me today, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after, we manage to find an open training facility to use.
